g0.establishes: The project has enforceable control of the full footprint it needs for development and construction, its zoning compatibility is known, and the community around it is mapped.
g0.milestone: Option, lease or purchase executed over the full project footprint.
g0.changed_3_0_0: The land option or lease must now be EXECUTED. Heads of terms on land no longer satisfy the gate.

g1.establishes: Electricity, water and critical utilities can realistically reach the plant at the capacity and timing the project assumes. For electrolysis, power is not an operating cost like any other: it sets production volume, cost, carbon intensity and certification eligibility at once.
g1.milestone: Interconnection study returned and queue position held (or behind-the-meter generation specified); PPA at least at term-sheet stage; water source and abstraction pathway identified.
g1.responsible: Grid and utilities · power procurement · legal (water)
g1.changed_3_0_0: Unchanged, except that the PPA item must now be at least INDICATIVE — an LOI no longer satisfies a slot whose own name says "signed or term sheet". The PPA must be EXECUTED by G10.
convergence_old: Contracted or generated MWh ↔ plant load
items: Connection Date vs COD Compatibility Memo
Signed PPA / Term Sheet / LOI Evidence
PPA Volume vs Plant Load Coverage Analysis
PPA Tenor vs Debt / Offtake Tenor Comparison
Curtailment Assessment (grid node congestion + load profile)
Dispatch / Load Factor Impact on Production Volume
Water Source Plan (volume, cost, seasonal availability)

g2.establishes: A named certification regime applies to this project and is demonstrably feasible for its configuration, with the eligibility premises — above all additionality — evidenced. This is the pathway, not the certificate.
g2.milestone: Scheme selected; additionality and temporal/geographic correlation evidenced; GHG methodology and MRV plan agreed.
g2.changed_3_0_0: Additionality restored — the platform registry had dropped it, although it is an RFNBO pillar and a deal-killer. The MRV plan the runtime lacked is added. Five items.
convergence_old: Power source and additionality ↔ chosen regime
GHG methodology ↔ process and energy inputs
items: Certification Scheme Selected (RFNBO / RED III / 45V / ISCC)
Additionality Evidence (generator age, no state aid)

g3.establishes: Feedstock and logistics are evidenced at terms a named counterparty has put on paper — volume, quality and tenor — consistent with the production case.
g3.milestone: Feedstock supply term sheet; transport and logistics study; storage plan.
g3.changed_3_0_0: Supply must now be at INDICATIVE maturity. The runtime accepted a letter of intent; the platform registry accepted a "strategy" and a "concept note" for a gate it called "Inputs Secured". Execution is required at G10 — a CO₂ supplier will not sign before the offtake that gives the plant a reason to exist. Renamed from "Key Inputs Secured"; the identifier keeps SECURED for stability.
convergence_old: Feedstock volume and quality ↔ process mass balance
supply tenor ↔ debt and offtake period

g4.establishes: A creditworthy buyer is contractually bound to take the product at a price that supports the debt, with the protections that make the contract financeable.
g4.milestone: Offtake executed; buyer credit assessed; credit support in place; take-or-pay, termination, assignment, step-in and pricing terms confirmed.
g4.changed_3_0_0: A term sheet no longer satisfies "binding". Nine items: the executed contract, the offtaker credit assessment the registry had dropped, credit support, and the bankability clauses — including the price-review mechanism, the clause through which a buyer moves terms after signature.
items: Credit Support (parent guarantee / letter of credit)

g5.establishes: Construction price, schedule and performance regime are settled in agreed form, so capital cost is a commitment rather than an estimate.
g5.milestone: EPC in agreed form, fixed price or capped GMP; liquidated damages; date-certain schedule; performance test protocol; interface matrix; OEM warranties; contractor due diligence.
g5.changed_3_0_0: Heads of terms no longer satisfy it; the agreed form does. Execution follows at G10. The performance test protocol moved here from G11 — the protocol is agreed with the EPC contractor; passing it is COD.
convergence_old: EPC price and schedule ↔ model and COD
items: EPC Contract — Fixed Price or Capped GMP (agreed form)
Interface Matrix (EPC / OEM / balance of plant)

g6.establishes: An Independent Engineer has issued a final, version-specific conclusion on the technical basis: energy balance, capital cost, operating cost and completion tests.
g6.milestone: IE report issued — final, not draft — with its component opinions.
g6.changed_3_0_0: An appointment letter no longer satisfies a sign-off. This is the most independence-critical gate in the model: the producer must never verify its own items here.
convergence_old: IE production and capex conclusions ↔ TEA and model base case
items: Energy Balance Verified by the IE

g7.establishes: Insurers have quoted the construction and operating programme on terms lenders accept — not merely that a broker has been appointed.
g7.milestone: Programme terms quoted by insurers; broker market report; deductible levels accepted by lenders; exclusions register reviewed.
g7.changed_3_0_0: The platform registry’s version would have deadlocked the ladder. It required cover BOUND with lenders named as loss payee at STRUCTURALLY_BANKABLE — two states before lenders approve credit. Lenders who have not approved cannot be named on a policy, and on a strictly sequential ladder nothing after that gate could pass. Binding and loss-payee endorsement are financial-close conditions and now sit at G10. A broker mandate no longer satisfies insurability. Renamed from "Insurance Bound"; the identifier keeps BOUND for stability.
convergence_old: Coverage and deductibles ↔ EPC and operating risks
items: Insurance Programme Terms — Quoted by Insurers

g8.establishes: The model used for the capital decision is locked, independently audited, and exposes downside cases and covenant effects.
g8.milestone: Locked base case; model audit opinion issued; downside cases; covenant suite; reserve logic; hedging plan; consistency with the IE.
g8.changed_3_0_0: "Audit-grade" now means audited. Before 3.0.0 neither definition required a completed audit — the runtime accepted an engagement letter, and the platform registry had no audit item at all.
convergence_old: Capex, opex and production ↔ verified TEA/IE basis
offtake and PPA terms ↔ model assumptions

g9.establishes: The pre-construction consents are granted and challenge risk is managed; the operating permit has a credible pathway.
g9.milestone: EIA granted; construction permit granted; ancillary permits granted; legal opinion on appeal risk; operating permit pathway.
g9.changed_3_0_0: Submissions and applications no longer satisfy it. The construction permit is named rather than folded into "ancillary". The operating permit must be in force at G11 — it cannot exist before the plant does.

g10.establishes: Financial close has happened: conditions precedent satisfied, equity injected, reserves funded, security perfected, insurance bound, legal opinions issued — and every readiness instrument from G1, G3, G5 and G7 now executed. This is where the ladder turns terms into commitments.
g10.changed_3_0_0: A draft CP checklist, draft legal opinions and a security "structure" no longer satisfy close. Legal opinions restored — the registry had dropped them. Insurance binding moved here from the registry’s G7.
convergence_old: funded equity and DSRA ↔ closing statement
security package ↔ asset and entity structure
items: Insurance Bound & Certificates Delivered (lenders as loss payee)
All Major Project Contracts Executed (PPA, feedstock, EPC, O&M, offtake)

g11.establishes: The plant works at the performance it was financed on, operates lawfully, reports its carbon, and has a stable operating record — which is what refinancing eligibility rests on.
g11.milestone: COD certified; performance tests passed; operating permit in force; MRV reporting live; 6–12 months of stable operation.
g11.changed_3_0_0: Plans and protocols no longer satisfy COD. The operating permit in force is added. As the terminal gate, the stabilization period blocks nothing downstream.
convergence_old: Tested capacity and efficiency ↔ model and guarantees
COD ↔ offtake, debt and refinancing dates
